hypothesis: H23: separating five questions into individual inference calls reduces cross-record question/answer assignment drift compared with the frozen batch request, while keeping all seven reviewed bank answers and the original answer labels.
controlled: Same system message, seven bank entries/order/content, original labels, question wording, model/temp/context. One question per request, one-record schema and instruction, generated-token cap240each(total1200).
acceptance: Aggregate all five terminal records in Q001..Q005 order. All5correct mappings required before any new chapter composition; independent full chapter/source/ENPT review still required. No per-question partial success promoted to accepted chapter.
limits: Five correlated development calls from same source family; not independent accuracy samples or certified holdout.
Prompt work is repeated, so latency/token cost is not assumed lower than batch.
Method changes isolate task segmentation including necessary schema/instruction changes, not a proof of internal model root cause.
